spatial_support.notes: Native 0.5 x 0.5 degree GCP cell containing the reference-window centre; the cell is much coarser than the 1.98 km window and is context only.

temporal_support.notes: Cumulative multi-year GCP composite, not a single acquisition and not a same-sol pair. No diurnal range is computed.

uncertainty.notes: No per-cell uncertainty is supplied by the GCP table.

notes: MGS TES TIMAP apparent thermal inertia (day or night retrieval) at the nearest native 2.96 km pixel. Different retrieval and support from the committed THEMIS 100 m product; never mixed with it.

spatial_support.notes: Nearest native 2.96 km TES TIMAP pixel to the reference-window centre. The pixel is larger than the 1.98 km window; this is coarse context, not a window mean.

temporal_support.notes: Three Mars years of TES observations (1999-2004) combined into a day/night map; per-pixel acquisition time is not carried.

uncertainty.notes: No per-pixel uncertainty layer is supplied; the data set refers to Putzig and Mellon (2007). The published derived range is 5-5000 J m^-2 K^-1 s^-1/2.

notes: PRP modeled annual average temperature at 2 cm depth. Not a measured surface temperature and not a local-time sample.

spatial_support.notes: Area-weighted mean of PRP triangle centroids inside the 1.98 km window; native mesh ~0.3-0.4 km, no resampling to 90 m.

temporal_support.notes: Annual average at 2 cm below the surface, derived from Diviner climatology and a Kaguya DEM; not a measured time series.

uncertainty.notes: Model-derived; no per-triangle uncertainty in the PRP product.
